report.summary: Sam demonstrates solid foundational experience in analytical R&D, specifically in HPLC method development, validation, and stability testing. To align with the Senior Scientist role, the resume needs to explicitly incorporate relevant regulatory frameworks and submission terminology present in the job description while highlighting leadership or coordination aspects.
